description.value:
A capricious and benevolent goddess worshipped on lost Golarion, Daikitsu's interests encompass everything that nurtures civilization. Unlike Abadar, whose faith easily transitioned to the modern, capitalist zeitgeist, Daikitsu's faith remains rooted in the bounty of the earth and the turning of the seasons, leading to a decline in her worship after the Gap. She remains the patron god of kitsune, vulkarisu, and other fox-like creatures, such as squoxes.

Title Lady of Foxes

Areas of Concern agriculture, craftsmanship, kitsune, vulkarisu

Edicts ensure the health of crops and vegetation, perfect a craft or trade, leave offerings for foxes and squoxes, celebrate the turning of the seasons

Anathema mistreat your tools, pass a beggar without giving alms, discriminate against sex workers or the lower class, commit murder or torture, harm an innocent
